eligibility: Exact original-case Unicode marked site equals its entire containing whitespace group, exactly one synthetic editorial marker. No gold-based length filtering.

training_type_support.candidate_domain: ALL train-attested exact expansions including rare; never held truth

context.scope: complete record, ordered lines then whitespace groups
context.hash: SHA256 UTF-8 key; first8 digest bytes as unsigned big endian modulo4096
context.value: counts then per-row L2 normalization; all-zero stays zero

layout: first source line in record indicator
last source line in record indicator
family_feature: onehot exact marked group among sorted training-qualified types; no learned category from held labels

models.L: linear family+layout with fixed log F offset
models.C: linear family+layout+context with fixed log F offset
models.N: one hidden layer64 ReLU on same C features with fixed log F offset

outputs: Sorted unique exact train expansion strings; softmax masked to each type’s full train candidate domain

training.shuffle: independent seeded epoch permutation generator reset to fold/seed for each arm; identical minibatch orders across L/C/N, separate from model initialization RNG
training.selection: none; final epoch each seed; arithmetic mean candidate probabilities
training.loss: masked candidate cross entropy, all qualified training sites equally weighted
training.loss_curve: sample-weighted mean online batch cross entropy per epoch, not full post-epoch reevaluation

primary_metric: For each held book, equal mean of exact expansion accuracy across its held qualified marked types; primary aggregate equal mean of four book metrics

context_gate.mean_definition: mean_book_macrotype(arm) - max(mean_book_macrotype(F),mean_book_macrotype(L)); positive folds compare arm against BOTH individually

tie_rule: lexicographically first exact candidate among maximal stored mean probabilities
secondary: all ambiguous sites correct per eligible record
training-defined terminal m/n pair subset with original support threshold
input-only novel exact sixteen-neighbor-group window among same-marked-type training windows; missing positions represented explicitly
all OOV truths counted as errors
train loss by epoch; underconvergence disclosed not repaired
scope_ceiling: no Voynich input or decoder permission
no neural necessity, nonlinearity causation, long-range grammar, semantic confirmation or significance claim
four related books not independent traditions
prediction_lock: Fit/prediction artifact hashes frozen before separate held scoring; prior analyst exposure disclosed
no_repairs: No architecture, normalization, candidate, threshold, epoch or hyperparameter changes after first real fit; implementation bugs may be corrected transparently with invalidated outputs retained.
secondary_mn_rule: Training-qualified exact marked type with two exact expansions sharing all characters except final m versus n; BOTH expansions individually meet >=5 sites and >=3 pages. Keep all its held sites and ALL other train candidate expansions.
